gloss: how many days; several days; what day of the month

definitions.explanation: Asks or refers to an unspecified number of days. Slightly formal or literary; in casual speech, {何日|なんにち} is far more common.

examples.japanese: {幾日|いくにち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いた→降り続く：21878_furitsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: It rained for many days on end.

examples.japanese: {幾日|いくにち}⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧だろう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many days have passed, I wonder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}た→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{幾日|いくにち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: He kept contacting them for days on end without waiting for a reply.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{幾|いく}→幾〜：00444_iku⟧ (how many; some) + ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (day). Has a literary or slightly formal feel and most often appears in the pattern {幾日|いくにち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (for many days). In casual everyday speech, use ⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧ for 'how many days?'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幾日|いくにち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: for many days; day after day
- {幾日|いくにち}⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: many days pass
- {幾日|いくにち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: many days ago

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧: how many days; what day — everyday standard form
- {幾日間|いくにちかん}: for how many days
- ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧: several days — neutral, common in writing
